verdict.line: You lose if you let Mundo farm you down with Infected Cleaver from range and regen it back with Adrenaline Rush; you win if you land Q's stun and burst him before level 6, before Sadism and his missing-health scaling come online.

brief.thesis: Dr. Mundo's Q (Infected Cleaver) deals damage based on your maximum health, and Volibear is one of the tankiest HP-stackers in the game — so your own itemization makes his poke hit harder in absolute numbers. Combine that with Adrenaline Rush healing him back every second he's not taking damage, and the lane becomes a race: can you close the gap with Q and burst him with W resets before his passive erases the trade. The 44.1% win rate over 229 games (below Volibear's own 48.3% lane average) says that race is currently tilted toward Mundo.

theirWindow.what: Masochism (E) gives him bonus AD scaling with missing health, so a low-HP Mundo swings harder, not softer. Don't walk into a 'finishing' trade here — disengage and let him walk it off instead.

yourWindow.when: Q (Thundering Smash) is up and he's overextended
yourWindow.what: Dash in with Q to stun him, then double-tap W (Frenzied Maul) on the same target for the bonus damage and self-heal. This window is strongest before level 6, since Sadism isn't online yet to bail him out.

powerCurve.note: E lets you answer Cleaver at range
R+Q stun punishes him before his R
max-health Q scales harder as you stack HP

start.why: The pick in 74.7% of games (45.7% WR) — the mana regen keeps your 5s-cooldown W spammable so you can trade W-into-W every time it's up and out-race his passive regen instead of running dry.

boots.why: Higher win rate of the two options (55.6% over 72 games) — the tenacity matters because Mundo's W (Burning Agony) and ganks are your real threat to lock-down, and the magic resist answers his mixed-damage kit.

core.why: Opens the highest-performing listed path (45% WR, 11.2% pick) with the tempo to start forcing trades.
Cooldown refund on crits keeps Q and W cycling faster, which is how you out-trade Adrenaline Rush tick for tick.
Amplifies the self-heal on your W recast and adds magic resist — directly counters the race against his passive regen and his magic-damage W drain.

situational.when: the game turns into a prolonged healing race and you need lifesteal/spell vamp to match his Adrenaline Rush
the game goes long and you need sustained DPS and omnivamp to grind through his max-health tankiness
you need wave clear and kiting speed to avoid walking into his 975-range Cleaver
he's stacking pure health and you need a burst spike to break through the regen before it ticks back

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramping attack speed over an extended fight lets your passive (The Relentless Storm) proc its bonus magic damage faster and gets your W resets online quicker — the only way to out-tempo Adrenaline Rush is to attack more often than he regens.

summoners.why: The standard pick at 75.7% (45.8% WR) — Ignite's healing reduction is the single best answer to a champion whose entire win condition is Adrenaline Rush and Sadism regen. Flash+Teleport (46.7% WR, 10.7% pick) is the alt if you'd rather scale and side-lane; Exhaust+Flash (47.8% WR, 8.2% pick) works if you want to shut down a Masochism-boosted all-in directly.

playing.title: Poke check with E
playing.detail: Sky Splitter (E, 1200 range, 16s CD) outranges his Infected Cleaver (975 range). Use it to answer his poke and get the shield bonus by standing in your own blast — don't just eat Cleavers waiting for Q range.

playing.title: Save Q for the stick
playing.detail: Thundering Smash (Q, 300 range, 12-10s CD depending on rank) only works if you're close enough to connect. Walking it down into open space lets him kite with his longer-range Q — wait for him to misposition near a wall or minion wave first.

playing.title: Double-tap W for the heal
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul (W) marks on first hit; recasting on the same target deals bonus damage and heals you. This W-into-W is your actual counter to Adrenaline Rush — single W pokes don't win the sustain race.

playing.title: Don't facetank a low-HP Mundo
playing.detail: Masochism (E) scales his bonus AD with missing health, so he hits hardest when he looks weakest. Treat a sub-40% Mundo as a bigger threat in melee, not a free kill.

playing.title: Track Sadism before you commit
playing.detail: Sadism (R, 75s CD) spikes his move speed and health regen on demand. Don't dump your own Stormbringer (R, 160-110s CD) into a fight he can pop R and simply run out of.

playing.title: Punish before level 6
playing.detail: Your solo-kill edge in this matchup is real but time-limited — it lives in the Q-stun-into-W-W window at levels 3-5, before his ultimate and missing-health scaling make trades safer for him.

playing.title: Respect the Burning Agony drain
playing.detail: Burning Agony (W) costs him health but deals continual damage to anyone nearby and cuts your stun's effective lock-down time. Don't assume a landed Q buys you a full-duration, damage-free window.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from real games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own read of the kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being chased by Dr.Mundo’s (Q) during early game. Use [E] to contest lane and use Phase Rush toclose in on him.
